name: Bachelorette Party
source:
It’s like every bachelorette party you’ve ever been to... chasing strippers through casinos, grand larceny, occasional encounters with the mafia, oh and COCKTAILS!

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Bachelorette_Party]Choices Wikia[/url]]
